title: Robust hybrid feature-driven on-the-fly mapping enables freehand 3D panoramic photoacoustic angiography

summary_en: Introduces PAATAM, a real-time freehand photoacoustic angiography tracking-and-mapping framework that estimates six-degree-of-freedom handheld-probe motion from complementary vascular geometry and absorption-intensity features. The system reconstructs field-of-view-unconstrained panoramic 3D vascular maps at 10 volumes per second, reports sub-1% relative tracking error in general and 99.67% accuracy under dynamic motion, and expands the imaged vascular volume 42.3-fold during a rat gastrectomy experiment.
